text:
ana: Quick sanity check on the regression-diff modal mock I uploaded. Main concern: primary CTA reads 'Approve' which feels ambiguous — are we approving the run, the diffs, or merging into the prompt set?
jamal: I hit the button and expected it to merge edits into the prompt set. :grimacing: We should align with mental model.
lucy: Suggestion: make primary action say 'Apply changes' and secondary 'Keep current'. Short enough for mobile and clearer.
sam: 'Apply' might sound like a code op. What about 'Merge changes' / 'Keep existing'?
maya: Users in support call it 'save prompt set' usually. We need consistent verbs across console: Save / Revert / Apply / Merge debate.
ana: (typo) ana: Accessibility note: current DOM order places the neutral action first, so screen readers encounter the secondary before the primary — that's backwards.
jamal: Filed a bug: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INFR-4921 — DOM button order and focus ring fix. I'll own it.
lucy: CTA A/B copy options to test:
- 'Apply changes' / 'Keep current'
- 'Approve changes' / 'Discard changes'
- 'Merge edits' / 'Cancel'
sam: For compact screens we should abbreviate: 'Apply' / 'Keep' and expose full labels on hover. Also show a small helper line under the CTA: 'Applies to gpt-3.5-redwood@v2' so users know target.
maya: Helper text is good — avoids long CTA text. Maybe use muted typography under the button.
design-bot: upload: /files/regression-modal-v4.png
lucy: Visual: primary color stronger teal, secondary outline. Contrast check shows primary (#06595a) on white passes WCAG AA at 14px. I'll double-check.
ana: I'll run the contrast tool and paste results.
jamal: UX for the scorecard: show inline change badges per test: e.g., 'unchanged' (grey), 'improved' (green), 'regressed' (red). Hover tooltip: 'Baseline score 0.82 -> 0.70, -0.12'.
sam: Add an aria-live region: '13 tests changed, 4 regressions' so screen reader users get quick context when diff loads.
maya: Also keyboard flow: when modal opens, focus should land on the primary action after scanning header details, not on the close X.
lucy: Tertiary action 'View full diff' is noisy in modal footer. Proposal: move it into kebab menu (⋯) to reduce clutter.
ana: Agree. Also ensure the kebab has an accessible label: 'More actions' and a visible focus outline.
jamal: API/product ask: when applying changes we should record which model & version. Button shouldn't be verbose, so helper row is better. Need telemetry event: prompt_set.apply with model, version fields.
sam: I'll add the telemetry spec in the PR.
design-bot: upload: /files/scorecard-badges-spec.png
lucy: Microcopy for toasts — we need consistent terminology. Candidates: 'Changes applied', 'Prompt set updated', 'Run approved'. We should map each action to a single canonical phrase in the style guide.
maya: I'll prototype two modal variations and the toast messages. Can we decide on verbs by EOD? @ana @sam please review.
ana: I'll also include keyboard-only screenshots and test notes.
jamal: Following up: I'll flip DOM order, add aria-live, file the telemetry ticket, and link a PR when ready.
ana: Thanks — small changes but big UX win. :tada:
